english_title: Basic Properties of This Distribution Function
statement_en: Let $(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$ be a measure space and let $f$ be measurable. Prove the following properties of the distribution function $\lambda_f(a)=\mu(\{x:|f(x)|>a\})$: (1) $\lambda_f$ is decreasing and right-continuous; (2) if $|f|\le |g|$, then $\lambda_f\le \lambda_g$; (3) if $|f_n|\uparrow |f|$, then $\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$; (4) if $f=g+h$, then $\lambda_f(a)\le \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$; (5) if $f=gh$, then $\lambda_f(a)\le \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$.
prerequisites: continuity from above and below of measures
callout_body:
1. $\lambda_f$是一个单调减少并且右连续的函数。
2. 如果$|f|\leq |g|$那么$\lambda_f \leq \lambda_g$
3. 如果$|f_n|\uparrow |f|$那么$\lambda_{f_n}\uparrow \lambda_f$
4. 如果$f = g+h$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(a/2)+\lambda_h(a/2)$
5. 如果$f = gh$那么$\lambda_f(a)\leq \lambda_g(\sqrt{a/2})+\lambda_h(\sqrt{a/2})$
